extracted.name: Bailey's Banana Colada
extracted.description: Alcoholic shake with Irish cream, banana and coconut cream.
instruction_lines: In a blender combine the bananas and banana liqueur; blend until smooth. Blend in the Irish cream and coconut cream (Note: Make sure the coconut cream is at room temperature, or you will not be able to pour it). Finally, add the ice and blend until smooth.
